The roof plan shows a 36 in pathway from eave to ridge on each roof plane and an 18 in ridge setback.

evidence.quote: 36 in pathway from eave to ridge on each roof plane.

evidence.quote: Structural attachment letter to follow under separate cover.

evidence.quote: Module: SunPeak SP-410M, 410 W. UL 61730 listed.
Inverter: VoltaLine VL-7600, 7.6 kW. UL 1741 listed.

criteria.finding: The owner, parcel number 01-3210-009-0270, and address 2210 Seagrape Drive match across the application form and the design sheets.

evidence.quote: 2210 Seagrape Drive. Parcel 01-3210-009-0270. Owner: Wei Chen.

rationale: Five of the six applicable criteria are met with evidence in the packet. The wind load letter for the High-Velocity Hurricane Zone is missing; the roof plan says it will follow but it has not arrived. Nothing else is open, so one request should complete the file.
letter:
Dear Wei Chen,

Thank you for your application MIA-2026-1149 for an 8.2 kW rooftop solar array at 2210 Seagrape Drive. We have reviewed your documents and need one item before we can continue:

1. Wind load letter (Florida Building Code §RS-5). It shows that the module attachments are designed for the wind speeds in the High-Velocity Hurricane Zone, and it must be signed and sealed by a Florida-registered engineer. Your roof plan says this letter will follow separately. Your contractor, Meridian Solar Co., can obtain it from their engineer and send it to us.

Everything else in your application meets the rooftop solar rules, so no other documents are needed.

Please reply by 5 Oct 2026 through the applicant portal or by email to permits@example.com. Call (305) 555-0100 if you have questions.

Building Department, City of Miami
